verdict.rationale: Operating a business-banking platform through natural-language commands, such as an AI assistant or conversational interface, is a fair question for this kind of SaaS product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes UI navigation, automated rules, and accounting integrations, with no natural-language command capability. The llms.txt file (relay-probe-1) is documentation published for LLMs to read, not a way to operate the product in natural language, so it earns no credit.
